note_en: In 以前大家最担心的是充电不方便 "what everyone used to worry about most was how hard charging was," 的 turns 大家最担心 into a noun phrase, "the thing everyone worries about most," and 是 then names it. This 'A 的是 B' frame works like the English "What... is..." sentence and moves the key information to the end; the text uses it again in 更重要的是 "what's more important is."
